in_sanskrit.name: काशी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The city that offers tranquility, peace, and salvation

in_marathi.name: Kashi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे City of Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kashi holds great significance in Hindu mythology. It is believed to be the city of Moksha, the final liberation from the cycle of birth and death. Kashi is also referred to as Varanasi or Banaras, and is situated on the banks of the sacred river Ganges. This city is considered to be one of the seven sacred cities of Hindus.
